protocol_registration.requirement: Independent macOS ImageIO/Core Image comparison at two distinct EDR headrooms; adjudicate code-domain versus decoded-domain interpolation when gamma != 1.

purpose: Adjudicate code-domain versus decoded-domain gain-map interpolation with gamma != 1 using an independent macOS Core Image renderer.
core_image_headroom_rule: Pass 2^H to CIImage.applyingGainMap(_:headroom:); Core Image's API uses a linear ratio while the registered independent variable H is in stops.

acceptance.rationale: The absolute floor is below the analytically generated H=0.5 separation (~0.009 for a 0.25 linear base) but above the C++ agreement tolerance; the ratio gate independently requires a fourfold preference for code-domain interpolation.
